```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

import plotly.graph_objects as go
from collections import defaultdict
import math

# name, city, country, lat, lon
members = [
    ("Floriana Anselmucci", "Enschede", "Netherlands", 52.2215, 6.8937),
    ("Georgios Belokas", "Athens", "Greece", 37.9838, 23.7275),
    ("Giovanni Biondi", "Messina", "Italy", 38.1938, 15.5540),
    ("David Boldrin", "Aberdeen", "United Kingdom", 57.1497, -2.0943),
    ("Vittoria Capobianco", "Oslo", "Norway", 59.9139, 10.7522),
    ("Giuseppe Cardile", "Reggio Calabria", "Italy", 38.1113, 15.6619),
    ("Rafaela Cardoso", "Lisbon", "Portugal", 38.7223, -9.1393),
    ("Manuela Cecconi", "Perugia", "Italy", 43.1122, 12.3888),
    ("Federica Cotecchia", "Bari", "Italy", 41.1171, 16.8719),
    ("Sabatino Cuomo", "Salerno", "Italy", 40.6824, 14.7681),
    ("Pantaleone De Vita", "Naples", "Italy", 40.8518, 14.2681),
    ("Silvano Emanuele Donvito", "Bari", "Italy", 41.1171, 16.8719),
    ("Alessandro Fraccica", "Rome", "Italy", 41.9028, 12.4964),
    ("Andrea Galli", "Milan", "Italy", 45.4642, 9.1900),
    ("Josif Josifovski", "Skopje", "North Macedonia", 41.9981, 21.4254),
    ("Jonathan Knappett", "Oxford", "United Kingdom", 51.7520, -1.2577),
    ("Anthony Leung", "Hong Kong", "Hong Kong SAR, China", 22.3193, 114.1694),
    ("Zhun Mao", "Montpellier", "France", 43.6108, 3.8767),
    ("Gerrit Meijer", "Bath", "United Kingdom", 51.3811, -2.3590),
    ("Luca Pagano", "Naples", "Italy", 40.8518, 14.2681),
    ("Vincenzo Pane", "Perugia", "Italy", 43.1122, 12.3888),
    ("Heleni Pantelidou", "London", "United Kingdom", 51.5074, -0.1278),
    ("Giuseppe Pedone", "Trento", "Italy", 46.0679, 11.1211),
    ("Josip Peranić", "Rijeka", "Croatia", 45.3271, 14.4422),
    ("Pasquale Perrini", "Cosenza", "Italy", 39.3086, 16.2537),
    ("Marianna Pirone", "Naples", "Italy", 40.8518, 14.2681),
    ("Federico Preti", "Florence", "Italy", 43.7696, 11.2558),
    ("Guido Rianna", "Lecce", "Italy", 40.3515, 18.1750),
    ("Riccardo Rigon", "Trento", "Italy", 46.0679, 11.1211),
    ("Enrique Romero", "Barcelona", "Spain", 41.3851, 2.1734),
    ("Hubert Savenije", "Delft", "Netherlands", 52.0116, 4.3571),
    ("Gianvito Scaringi", "Prague", "Czech Republic", 50.0755, 14.4378),
    ("Volker Schlüter", "Karlsruhe", "Germany", 49.0069, 8.4037),
    ("Joel Smethurst", "Southampton", "United Kingdom", 50.9097, -1.4044),
    ("Nico Stasi", "Bari", "Italy", 41.1171, 16.8719),
    ("Vito Tagarelli", "Bari", "Italy", 41.1171, 16.8719),
    ("Alessandro Tarantino", "Glasgow", "United Kingdom", 55.8642, -4.2518),
    ("Katerina Tsiampousi", "London", "United Kingdom", 51.5074, -0.1278),
    ("Gianfranco Urciuoli", "Naples", "Italy", 40.8518, 14.2681),
    ("Marco Uzielli", "Florence", "Italy", 43.7696, 11.2558),
    ("Jean Vaunat", "Barcelona", "Spain", 41.3851, 2.1734),
    ("Giulia Viggiani", "Cambridge", "United Kingdom", 52.2053, 0.1218),
    ("Anil Yildiz", "Aachen", "Germany", 50.7753, 6.0839),
    ("Lidija Zdravkovic", "London", "United Kingdom", 51.5074, -0.1278),
]

# aggregate members that share a city so pins don't stack
groups = defaultdict(list)
for name, city, country, lat, lon in members:
    groups[(city, country, lat, lon)].append(name)

lats, lons, hovers, counts = [], [], [], []
for (city, country, lat, lon), names in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
    n = len(names)
    lats.append(lat)
    lons.append(lon)
    counts.append(n)
    names_html = "<br>".join(f"&#8226; {nm}" for nm in sorted(names))
    hovers.append(f"<b>{city}, {country}</b><br>{n} member{'s' if n != 1 else ''}<br>{names_html}")

# area-proportional marker size
marker_sizes = [10 + 9 * math.sqrt(c) for c in counts]

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Scattermap(
        lat=lats,
        lon=lons,
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(size=marker_sizes, color="#3A6EA5", opacity=0.88),
        text=hovers,
        hoverinfo="text",
        hovertemplate="%{text}<extra></extra>",
    )
)

fig.update_layout(
    map=dict(style="carto-positron", center=dict(lat=48.5, lon=8), zoom=2.85),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0),
    height=560,
    hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor="#1F2933", font=dict(color="#F4F6F8", size=12), align="left"),
    showlegend=False,
)

fig
```
